# Kashi Live News 24

> Kashi Live News 24 is a Hindi digital news platform focused on Varanasi, Kashi and Banaras, covering local news, crime, traffic, education, jobs, sports, health, weather, politics and public information.

The site presents a mix of original/community-reviewed reporting and clearly attributed summaries from external publishers and public sources. External stories should be read with the listed source attribution and original-source link.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://kashi-livenews24.vercel.app/): Latest Varanasi and Kashi news.
- [Search](https://kashi-livenews24.vercel.app/search): Search the news index.
- [News archive](https://kashi-livenews24.vercel.app/archive): Archived stories when available.
- [About](https://kashi-livenews24.vercel.app/about): About Kashi Live News 24.
- [Contact](https://kashi-livenews24.vercel.app/contact): Contact and news-tip information.
- [Send news](https://kashi-livenews24.vercel.app/send-news): Submit a local news tip for editorial review.
- [Editorial policy](https://kashi-livenews24.vercel.app/editorial-policy): Editorial and source-handling policy.
- [Correction policy](https://kashi-livenews24.vercel.app/correction-policy): Corrections and factual-error policy.
- [Privacy policy](https://kashi-livenews24.vercel.app/privacy-policy): Privacy information.
- [Disclaimer](https://kashi-livenews24.vercel.app/disclaimer): News-feed and external-source disclaimer.
- [Terms](https://kashi-livenews24.vercel.app/terms): Website usage terms.
- [Advertising](https://kashi-livenews24.vercel.app/advertise): Advertising information.
- [Social updates](https://kashi-livenews24.vercel.app/social): Publicly indexed Facebook and Instagram-related updates.

## Coverage

- Varanasi
- Kashi
- Crime
- Traffic
- Politics
- Education
- Business
- Sports
- Weather
- Jobs
- Health
- Entertainment
- Technology
- Uttar Pradesh
- India

## Source handling

- Prefer current, attributed source information.
- External stories include source attribution where available.
- User-submitted material is intended for editorial review before publication.
- Time-sensitive public-safety, travel, weather and official information should be independently checked against the responsible authority when needed.
